label: Eisenhardt (2021), What is the Eisenhardt Method, really?

claims.text: The method's singular organizing aim is theory building—especially from multiple cases and theoretical logic—with defining features including non-obvious research questions, deliberate case selection, clearly identified constructs and relationships, theoretical mechanisms, and boundary conditions.

Theoretical sampling selects cases where the focal phenomenon is likely and designs similarities and differences across cases to sharpen focus, reduce alternative explanations, and improve theoretical generalizability; designs may include matched pairs, racing cases, and polar types.

Analysis combines constant comparison between emergent theory and data, treating cases as standalone replications, systematic within- and cross-case comparison, and explicit development of why-theoretical arguments rather than pattern description alone.

A fixed data type, a fixed number of cases, performance as a necessary outcome, and a variance-only theory form are not defining requirements; 4–10 cases are common but not a rule, and single cases with embedded replication may also support the logic.

Eisenhardt's later position is ontologically and epistemologically flexible: she retains an objective-reality commitment while recognizing social construction, unavoidable researcher influence, and the art involved in constructing concepts and relationships.

The 2021 refresh broadens the method beyond a blank-slate reading to theory elaboration/abduction, calls for greater attention to time, and proposes complementarity with machine learning; it does not itself provide a reusable computational implementation.
